Fixing Every Variable to Its Hint Tests Whether the Hint Is Feasible

recorded.prompt:q-bad-hint: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-bad-hint: "a hint may cover only some variables, may even be infeasible... It is guidance, not a rule"; "The hinted run still works (a hint is never a constraint)".
recorded.prompt:q-partial-hint: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-partial-hint: "The setting fixes hinted variables only; a variable with no hint stays free for the solver to set." So OPTIMAL shows the 12 fit within some rule-keeping plan.
recorded.prompt:q-all-named: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-all-named: "the set is minimized but not guaranteed minimal"; when all 28 came back, "The answer is true... but useless... To get an answer a planner can act on, shrink it."

recorded.prompt:q-bad-hint:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bad-hint:a: "may even be infeasible"; the budget-cut hinted run returned FEASIBLE.
recorded.prompt:q-bad-hint:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bad-hint:b: "The old plan... is no longer a plan at all." The hinted run's best was $209,900k, not the old plan.
recorded.prompt:q-bad-hint:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bad-hint:d: "budgets cut 3%  hint  FEASIBLE"; "no plan is ever refused for disagreeing with a hint."
recorded.prompt:q-partial-hint:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-partial-hint:b: "A check that hints only the ones would therefore accept a plan that leaves out a must-do project, since the solver is free to switch that project on."
recorded.prompt:q-partial-hint:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-partial-hint:c: OPTIMAL means best "of the plans left", with the 12 fixed. That is not the best plan overall.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-hint:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-partial-hint:d: "The setting fixes hinted variables only; a variable with no hint stays free". It does not reject a partial hint.
recorded.prompt:q-all-named:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-all-named:a: All 28 were named, yet the deletion filter shrank them to 3: "Twenty-eight rules shrink to three."
